_schema.why: The single source of the 'human reviewed' claim. `npm run verify:q` reads this file and writes it into audit/verification-coverage.json, so the published coverage figure cannot be typed anywhere by hand. An entry naming a concept the bank does not generate, or lacking a reviewer and a date, FAILS the audit — a review claim without a name and a date is not evidence.

fields.conceptId: must be a concept the bank can generate (GENERATED_CONCEPT_IDS)
fields.reviewer: the person who read the items — a name or a stable handle. NOT 'the team' and NOT a placeholder: `npm run verify:q` REFUSES a placeholder name, because the example in this very file ('A. Teacher') was once recorded as a qualified reviewer for ten concepts that nobody had read
fields.checklistVersion: which version of the review checklist in docs/PILOT_SCOPE.md was used
fields.scope: what was actually read — e.g. 'all four option families at 60 draws each, and every explanation'
fields.notes: optional; what was found, and what was changed as a result

example.scope: 12 draws covering both families, explanations read in full
